question: The balloon started to deflate after being pricked with a needle. What is the ANTONYM of ‘deflate’?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"deflate"** means to let air or gas out of (a tire, balloon, or similar object), causing it to lose its shape. (हवा निकालना)

 
 
• **Example: **The tire began to deflate after it ran over a sharp object.
 
 
 
• **"Inflate"** refers to filling (a balloon, tire, or other expandable structure) with air or gas so that it becomes distended. (फुलाना)
 
 
• **Example: **We need to inflate the balloons before the party starts.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'deflate'** is **'inflate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Compress **(संपीड़ित करना): To press or squeeze something so that it becomes smaller or more compact.

 
 
• **Example:** You can compress the file to make it easier to email.
 
 
 
• **Shrink **(सिकुड़ना): To become or make smaller in size or amount.
 
 
• **Example: **My sweater shrank in the wash.
 
 
 
• **Flatten** (समतल करना): To make or become flat or flatter.
 
 
• **Example:** The construction workers will flatten the ground before building.
 
 

 

38:Tbc7,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
